description: Generate publication-quality LaTeX tables from experimental results. Convert JSON/CSV data to bookta

interface.shortDescription: Generate publication-quality LaTeX tables from experimental results. Convert JSON/CSV data to bookta
interface.longDescription: Generate publication-quality LaTeX tables from experimental results. Convert JSON/CSV data to booktabs-styled tables with bold best results, multi-row layouts, and proper captions. Use when creating result tables, comparison tables, or ablation tables for papers.
